english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an adult male or men collectively, including a male member of a group when the role is clear from context.

exampleSentences.english: That man is the new colleague.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰個男人係新嚟嘅同事。
exampleSentences.jyutping: go2 go3 naam4 jan4 hai6 san1 lei4 ge3 tung4 si6

english.note: Use this for the male-person meaning, rather than for a companion or a generic individual.

exampleSentences.jyutping: go2 go3 naam4 jan4 gei2 jau5 jing4 wo3

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose word when “gentleman” simply means a man.

exampleSentences.jyutping: go2 go3 naam4 jan4 gei2 gou1

english.note: Choose this over 男仔 when the male person is an adult man.

exampleSentences.english: The male living next door often helps the neighbors move things.
exampleSentences.traditional: 隔籬個男人成日幫鄰居搬嘢。
